app.name: AutoDownloadarr
app.tagline: Watch once, then let it go.

setup.title: Set up AutoDownloadarr
setup.subtitle: A few steps and you are ready to watch.

account.label: Account
account.title: Create your admin account
account.description: This account signs in to the web interface. You can add more users later.
account.tokenHint: Printed in the server log on first start, e.g. run: docker logs autodownloadarr
account.usernameHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.

usenet.label: Usenet
usenet.title: Add your Usenet provider
usenet.description: The built-in downloader fetches and unpacks releases directly from your provider. Test the connection before saving.

indexer.label: Indexer
indexer.title: Add an indexer
indexer.description: Releases are searched on Newznab-compatible indexers (Prowlarr works too).

library.label: Movies
library.title: Movies folder and metadata
library.description: Where temporary movies are stored, and the TMDB key used to search for movies.

mediaServer.label: Plex
mediaServer.title: Connect Plex
mediaServer.description: New movies appear in your Plex library as soon as they are ready; watched ones are cleaned up automatically.

done.label: Done
done.title: You are all set
done.description: Missing parts can be added later under Settings.

errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.

dashboard.subtitle: What do you want to watch today?
dashboard.setupPending: The setup is not finished yet.

movies.title: Movies
movies.none: No movies requested yet. Search for one above.
movies.tmdbMissing: Enter a TMDB API key to search for movies.

releases.title: Releases
releases.description: Results of the last search, best first. You can start any of them manually.
releases.name: Release

blocklist.title: Blocklist
blocklist.description: These releases failed and are not tried again.

problems.indexer_error: The indexer could not be reached
problems.usenet_auth: The Usenet server rejected the login
problems.no_video: No video file in the release
problems.spam: Spam (password only on a web site)

general.title: General
general.description: Where movies are stored and when they are deleted again.
general.moviesPathHint: Path inside the container. Add the same folder to Plex as a separate library.
general.maxSourcesHint: After this many failed releases the movie needs your attention.
general.watchPollMinutesHint: How often Plex is asked what was watched.
general.seriesPathHint: Path inside the container. Add it to Plex as a separate TV library.

tmdb.title: TMDB
tmdb.description: Movies are searched on The Movie Database. Create a free API key under themoviedb.org → Settings → API.
tmdb.saved: The key works and has been saved.
tmdb.key: API key or read access token
tmdb.keyHint: Both the v3 API key and the v4 read access token work.

usenet.title: Usenet servers
usenet.description: Primary servers are used first; backup servers (block accounts) only for missing articles.
usenet.connectionsHint: At most as many as your provider allows.
usenet.name: Name

indexers.title: Indexers
indexers.description: Newznab-compatible indexers. Use Test to check the API key and load the categories.
indexers.testOk: Connected. Movie search by {{params}} is supported.
indexers.testOkTextOnly: Connected. This indexer only supports text search.
indexers.urlHint: Base URL of the indexer or the Newznab URL from Prowlarr.
indexers.name: Name

plex.title: Plex
plex.description: Sign in with Plex, choose the server and the library for temporary movies.
plex.waiting: Waiting for the sign-in in the Plex window…
plex.tokenHint: X-Plex-Token of an account with access to the server.
plex.noServers: No Plex server found for this account.
plex.pickServer: Choose a server and how to reach it:
plex.libraryHint: Preferably a separate library that only contains AutoDownloadarr's movies.
plex.mappingsHint: If Plex sees the movies folder under a different path, e.g. /movies here and /mnt/hdd/movies on the Plex server.
plex.tvLibraryHint: A TV library containing the series folder.

profile.title: Quality profile
profile.description: Which releases are allowed and which are preferred.
profile.requiredWordsHint: Comma separated, e.g. German. Whole words, /regex/ is possible.
profile.forbiddenWordsHint: Releases containing one of these words are skipped.
profile.preferredWordsHint: word=points, e.g. DL=100. Higher scores win.

password.known: Only if the password is known

profile.allowLowQualityHint: CAM, TS, TC and screener copies.

passwords.title: Archive passwords
passwords.description: Tried for encrypted archives when neither the NZB nor the release name carries the password.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Other devices will be signed out.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_setup_token: The setup token is not correct.
errors.invalid_username: The username may only contain letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (max. 64 characters).
errors.weak_password: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
errors.setup_completed: Setup has already been completed. Please sign in.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.loadFailed: Could not load data from the server.
errors.not_configured: This needs to be configured first.
errors.rate_limited: The service limits requests right now. Try again later.
errors.path_not_writable: The folder does not exist or is not writable. Use an absolute path inside the container.
errors.invalid_state: Not possible in the current state.

series.title: Series
series.settingsHint: Applies right away: the window grows or shrinks, new seasons are fetched.
series.windowSizeHint: How many unwatched episodes are kept ready.

triggers.progress: when the next one is watched to …
triggers.minutes: … minutes after the next one started

request.description: Choose the seasons and how many episodes should be kept ready.
request.defaultsHint: Defaults are set by the administrator.
